answers.core: Core: Base UI controls for the editor.
answers.workaround:
Frankly this isn't the worst place to have to single-select files, since localization files only need to be added once. However, it is still very inconvenient and a bit disappointing every time I want to add some translations.

Consider this a low priority request, but I wanted to request it nonetheless. The Godot Editor seems oddly inconsistent (to me, at least) with when it does and does not allow multi-selection of files, so I fear there might be some underlying reason why multi-selection isn't allowed here.

title: Allow Multi Selection of `.translation` files in Project Settings - Localization
